scope: PART 17 ONLY (ss 151 to 159: the assurance fund, the Registrar's summons, the stated case, actions for the recovery of land, the s 155 action for damages against the fund, procedure and costs, protection of bona fide purchasers and officials, the 12-year limitation period, and the Registrar's power to correct the land-register), together with the two sections outside Part 17 that it cannot be read without: s 46 (indefeasibility, which does the barring that s 155(1) requires) and s 51A(4) (electronic lodgment, which relieves the Registrar of the duty to inquire and so narrows what can count as a mistake of the Registrar). ONE PART OF NINETEEN, out of an Act of about 325,000 characters. NOT ENCODED: registration, caveats, easements, leases, mortgages, charges, strata, the court's rectification power in s 160, and everything else. No rules under the Act were retrieved, including the rules that fix the proportion of fees constituting the assurance fund under s 151(1).
